title: JRC Global Surface Water Monthly
description: This publication is a byte-for-byte mirror of the JRC (European Commission Joint Research Centre) Global Surface Water Monthly History tiles for 2017 to 2024, in two editions: VER5-0 under tiles/ for 2017 to 2021, and V1.5 under v1_5/ for 2022 to 2024. This republication does not include the full 1984 to present history.
